name: Ecommerce-theta
description: Two-sided marketplace API with Stripe Connect: destination charges, platform fees and seller payouts. Express, TypeScript, MongoDB, role-based access.

paragraphs: A two-sided e-commerce marketplace API with Stripe Connect integration. Buyers purchase from sellers; the platform collects a configurable fee on every transaction; sellers receive payouts directly to their bank accounts.
Live storefront · Angular frontend on Vercel that uses this API

At a glance: Stripe Express Connect onboarding with Stripe-hosted KYC · destination charges with a configurable platform fee (default 10%) · raw-body webhook verification and idempotent order creation · seller status synced from account.updated · orders cancelled automatically on paymentintent.paymentfailed · RBAC for buyers, sellers and admins
features: Seller onboarding via Stripe Express Connect accounts with Stripe-hosted KYC
Buyer checkout using Stripe Checkout Sessions (destination charges)
Configurable platform fee (default 10%) deducted from every transaction
Automatic fund transfer to seller's bank account after platform fee
Seller dashboard with revenue stats, order management, and payout history
